title: Unaligned AVX-512 vector store faulting on memory page boundary in GEMM kernel
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0112: Unaligned AVX-512 vector store faulting on memory page boundary in GEMM kernel
Repository: `llvm/llvm-project`
Category: `Memory Safety & Undefined Behavior`
Target File: `kernel/simd/gemm_avx512.c`

#### Problem Description
_mm512_store_ps called on 16-byte aligned pointer instead of required 64-byte boundary, triggering GP fault.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Use _mm512_storeu_ps for arbitrary alignment or enforce posix_memalign 64-byte allocation.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0112.py -q`
expected_invariant: Use _mm512_storeu_ps for arbitrary alignment or enforce posix_memalign 64-byte allocation.
